title: Hedge Iris董事：智谱估值极端，建议谨慎

segments.en: And that's for next year. So we're looking at four valuation versus Jirupu valuation. That's how extreme where Jirupu has gone up.
segments.zh: 这是明年的数据。所以我们看到的是4倍估值对比智谱的估值，这就是智谱涨幅的极端程度。

segments.en: I understand it's a huge AI beneficiary right now. And a lot of investors are parting like 1999, but I'm not sure that party will last much, much longer.
segments.zh: 我理解它现在是AI的巨大受益者，很多投资者像1999年那样狂欢，但我不确定这场派对能持续多久。

segments.en: There are some lock-ups. Feel it? Yeah, cover, side. Yes. No, no, that's true. The lock-up period is coming up. So there is an additional factor to consider in terms of selling.
segments.zh: 还有一些锁定期。感觉到了吗？是的，没错。锁定期即将到来，所以抛售方面还有一个额外因素需要考虑。

segments.en: Well, my simple question is what would make you change your mind? And if you don't like this stock, is there any other company within the Chinese ecosystem that you like that you think is, apart from deep seek, of course, in the public markets which you think investors should favor instead?
segments.zh: 我的简单问题是，什么会让你改变看法？如果你不喜欢这只权益资产，在中国生态系统中，除了DeepSeek，还有哪些公开市场上的公司你认为投资者应该青睐？

segments.en: So at the moment, we're actually kind of cautious on China Internet. And my go-to proxy for anthropic in China is actually Keemi.
segments.zh: 目前我们对中国的互联网板块持谨慎态度。我在中国看好的Anthropic对标其实是Keemi。
